name: Chocolate Cage
source:
This was the last Valentine's Day of my high school life.

I, who had no luck with love, thought Valentine's Day would end uneventfully like it always does, but...

"Everything was going just as I planned."


[From [url=http://twinproject.weebly.com/chocolate-cage.html]Twin Project[/url]]
translation:
这是我高中生活的最后一个情人节。

没有爱情的我，本以为情人节会像往常一样平平安安地结束，但是……

“一切都按照我的计划进行。”


[来自[url=http://twinproject.weebly.com/chocolate-cage.html]Twin Project[/url]]
